brief:
Residents of Hebron's Old City have regained access to water through restored wells, Al Jazeera English reported. The Old City has endured a prolonged siege involving Israeli settlers and military presence, which had disrupted basic services including water supply to Palestinian residents.

The restoration of the wells addresses a critical shortage that has affected daily life in the densely populated area. The project represents efforts to sustain Palestinian communities despite the ongoing restrictions imposed by the occupation.
dek: Hebron's Old City has been under constant siege by Israeli settlers and the military.
title: Restored wells revive water access in occupied Hebron Old City
